summary: Rate $30 and Campspot confirmed; added 161 fitting sites to 60 ft, showers, dump, wifi. Water off Dec-Apr per Campspot; season left unset.
flags: FAIRGROUND RULE: passes. Its own site's Camping menu links straight to the Campspot engine, which sells ordinary nights May-October 2027 to anyone (no event requirement), rate published, phone published. Campspot: 'With ample room for camping enthusiasts, the grounds extend their hospitality most of the year, even allowing primitive camping during the winter months when water services are temporarily turned off from December to April.' No event-closure notice found; the July fair dates still list sites (2027-07-20 read). The site has no camping page of its own, only that link.

SEASON left unset: Campspot's description says camping runs most of the year with primitive winter camping, but the engine offers nothing on 2026-11-10, 2027-01-12, 03-16 or 04-13, so winter camping would be by phone; no opening or closing date is stated.

PHONE: stored 765-288-1854 is the fairgrounds office on delcofairgrounds.com/contact-us (kept). Campspot's park record gives 765-744-0086 for the campground. Give both a look if a dedicated camping line is wanted; I could not establish who answers it.
Campspot's premium type lists Class A; every other type omits Class A but lists Motorhome Class C, which is EKKO. Types 'East Side - Uneven' omit fifth wheels and travel trailers only.
Pin 40.20519,-85.39273 equals the operator's own Campspot lat/lng; the grounds are compact in town.
